request:
덕테이프 포스터로 가상 브랜드 온빛의 데스크 램프 체험전을 안내해줘. 첨부 상품 사진을 실제로 참고해 짙은 초록색, 넓고 휘어진 가로 갓, 연결된 두 지지대와 타원형 받침의 특징을 보존하고 각 포스터에서 제품 전체가 한 번은 보여야 해. 표현 방식을 바꿀 수 있고 배경이나 포스터 배치는 보존 조건이 아니야. 실제 출시 정보나 업체 로고는 만들지 말아줘. 제품의 구조와 책상 위의 빛을 경험하는 행사로 느껴지게 해줘. 디지털 홍보용 16:9 가로 포스터를 서로 다른 전체 스타일 다섯 장으로 만들어줘. 본문 설명과 일정·장소·방문 조건·웹주소가 시선의 흐름 안에서 자연스럽게 이어져 읽혀야 해. 제목만 눈에 띄고 본문은 구석에 흩어지거나 작은 글자로 눌리지 않게 해줘. 단색 바탕의 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 상품 그림을 부가한 템플릿, 글자를 담기 위한 빈 실내 면의 구성은 제외해줘. 아래 문구를 각각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

common_constraints: Prioritize the concrete positive first-generation design and naturally connected body copy. Print full copy once in the native tool brief, no rubric or plan dump.
The current user request and exact product fixture are authoritative; implementation guidance is not an invented client-fixed coordinate/grid/font condition.
Use collected ideas; do not browse source websites or re-open studio/Canva originals for this request. Only the exact supplied lamp fixture is a mandatory viewed/native reference.
Five different whole styles; no common info panel, font or title-first layout added.
Do not read peer production or external quality feedback. Close own selection before independent evaluation.

directions.name: 연속 사진 편집
directions.concept: Use closely related views of the complete lamp and its light falling across a real open book as a photographic editorial sequence. The sequence itself organises the whole composition; not an empty room backdrop.
directions.image_grammar: Natural photographic depth, distinct whole-product and illuminated-page crops joined through a clear editing seam; no copied film frames. Product complete in one view with the reference geometry/color.
directions.body_flow: A lamp/light contact point leads into the two description sentences adjacent to the image seam. Keep those sentences continuous in a comfortably readable column. Continue from that column into an adjoining event/date/place group then visit/invitation/URL; related information shares optical starts and predictable spacing. The title labels the visual story and does not consume body area.
directions.type: Mature low-contrast Korean/Latin sans body, uniform glyph proportions/open counters, balanced numerals, moderate weight, semantic wrapping and calm consistent leading. Headline can have stronger optical mass without scaling that styling down into body.
directions.distinctness: Image sequence and an editorial seam organise reading, rather than an ink silhouette/diagram/painted still life or luminous abstraction.

directions.name: 두 색 판화의 빛과 구조
directions.concept: A controlled relief-print composition: deep forest-green lamp structure and warm-light book/page shapes form an interlocking diagonal print rather than a big isolated object on passive field. Show one complete accurate lamp.
directions.image_grammar: Flat ink masses, deliberate directional hatch and crisp plate boundaries; shape rhythms derive from shade curvature and book/page light. No toy mascot or arbitrary print symbols.
directions.body_flow: The complete lamp silhouette and lit paper-plane boundary lead to the title and first description within a connected readable plane. Second description follows in the same text rhythm. A nearby change in the printed plane leads to event/date/place, then visit/bring-book/URL in an adjacent related group. No corner-by-corner sentences.
directions.type: Body in a robust modest-contrast Korean serif with open counters and consistent fine strokes, compatible Latin/numerals. Headline may use cut-ink character but fine body stays precise. Meaningful line wraps; group gap stronger than interline gap.
directions.distinctness: Ink silhouette and intersecting light/page planes actively shape the whole; not photographic sequence or a photograph as main centre.

directions.name: 제품 구조의 그래픽 도해
directions.concept: Create an architectural graphic explanation of shade, supports and light on paper with the intact product incorporated into the line/plane system. Line drawing and precise full-product photograph join at meaningful real parts; no invented internal mechanics or dimensions.
directions.image_grammar: Sharp drafted outlines, controlled large-scale light footprints and carefully joined product/photo detail boundaries. Diagram is about visible structure and illumination, not unsupported specs or numbered fake labels.
directions.body_flow: Visible horizontal shade and the light footprint organise a stepped yet aligned reading path. Connect the main explanation paragraph to that footprint, then the nearby event/date/place group and contiguous visit details/URL. All copy roles find the next group through shared baselines or a real image boundary. Do not scatter unrelated annotations around each part.
directions.type: Refined compact Korean/Latin sans of stable proportions with readable counters and measured medium weight. Body and practical group use consistent system; numeric/date emphasis is restrained relative to the explanation. No fake tiny technical printing.
directions.distinctness: Precise lines, functional visible-product relationships and stepped alignments, instead of film-like montage, painted scenic depth or print hatching.

directions.name: 회화적인 책상 정물
directions.concept: A considered painted still life of the complete forest-green lamp, an open book and paper on a lived-in desktop. The lamp and pages share coherent gouache planes and brush description density; adult restrained illustration, not cute generic watercolor.
directions.image_grammar: Specific sharp/soft contour choices, consistent perspective, green structural planes and warm bounded illumination; the book/page edges produce a continuous winding spatial rhythm. Keep supplied lamp identity through rendering translation.
directions.body_flow: Enter through the lit book/green lamp relation, then into a substantial adjacent explanation paragraph aligned with the visible page edge. Event/date/place follows that paragraph rather than appearing in a distant corner; visit/bring-book/URL sits at the next joined still-life boundary. The title participates in the pictorial rhythm, not a separate giant heading.
directions.type: Mature low/moderate-contrast Korean serif body with enough weight and open internal spaces, proportionate Latin/dates. Precise upright small type distinct from painterly image edges; do not paint every body glyph roughly.
directions.distinctness: A unified pictorial still-life perspective and controlled brush grammar, rather than a photo-backed template or graphic light-footprint diagram.

directions.name: 빛의 크롭과 컬러 사진 몽타주
directions.concept: An original photographic montage built from complete accurate lamp and large cropped illuminated folded-paper surfaces. The light/paper folds organise the whole composition and create scale/colour tension; not a blank room/wall for title panels.
directions.image_grammar: Strong oblique photo crop boundaries, warm-light/forest-green colour tension, visible folded-paper depth and a precise complete lamp across an intersecting crop. Only justified crops of this product/light theme, no chrome/blobs/toy effects.
directions.body_flow: A folded-paper light edge carries the first view into the two contiguous description sentences. The main title relates to the intersecting crop as a second anchor. Event/date/place and visit/invitation/URL join the description reading plane through clear shared edge/spacing, each function remains a coherent block. Keep the paragraph readable horizontally rather than lettering around a curved form.
directions.type: Distinctive restrained humanist Korean/Latin sans body, balanced apertures and moderate width, stable baseline and carefully paced multiline paragraph. Stronger italic/oblique title treatment may be used only if Korean letterforms stay coherent; body remains stable.
directions.distinctness: Oblique photo crops and illuminated-paper scale tension actively construct space, unlike the calm editorial sequence, drafted plan or painted still life.

source_role: ROOT coordinates from current request and previously collected attraction/design ideas; no new external reference research or source re-open approval actor.
